name: Wi-Fi at maximum performance
description: Stops the Wi-Fi adapter from dozing between packets, both on charger and on battery. Removes the small delays and spikes power saving adds to every round trip.

name: Keep network adapters awake
description: Turns off "Allow the computer to turn off this device to save power" for every physical network adapter, so the connection never has to wake up mid game.

operations.restore: $saved = if ($state) { $state | ConvertFrom-Json } else { $null }; foreach ($a in $adapters) { $value = if ($saved -and $saved.($a.Name)) { $saved.($a.Name) } else { 'Enabled' }; Set-NetAdapterPowerManagement -Name $a.Name -AllowComputerToTurnOffDevice $value -NoRestart }

name: Low latency Ethernet
description: Turns off Energy Efficient Ethernet, Green Ethernet and interrupt moderation on wired adapters. Packets are handled the moment they arrive instead of being batched. Applies after the adapter reconnects.

operations.restore: $saved = if ($state) { $state | ConvertFrom-Json } else { $null }; foreach ($p in $props) { $key = $p.Name + '|' + $p.RegistryKeyword; $value = if ($saved -and $saved.$key) { $saved.$key } else { '1' }; Set-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $p.Name -RegistryKeyword $p.RegistryKeyword -RegistryValue $value -NoRestart }

name: Disable Nagle's algorithm
description: Sends small TCP packets immediately instead of bundling them. Helps games that use TCP, such as many MMOs. Games on UDP, including CS2 and Valorant, are not affected.

operations.capture: $saved = @{}; foreach ($i in $ifs) { $p = Get-ItemProperty $i.PSPath; $saved[$i.PSChildName] = @{ ack = $p.TcpAckFrequency; nodelay = $p.TCPNoDelay } }; $saved | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
operations.apply: foreach ($i in $ifs) { Set-ItemProperty $i.PSPath -Name TcpAckFrequency -Value 1 -Type DWord; Set-ItemProperty $i.PSPath -Name TCPNoDelay -Value 1 -Type DWord }
operations.restore: $saved = if ($state) { $state | ConvertFrom-Json } else { $null }; foreach ($i in $ifs) { $entry = if ($saved) { $saved.($i.PSChildName) } else { $null }; foreach ($pair in @(@('TcpAckFrequency', 'ack'), @('TCPNoDelay', 'nodelay'))) { $value = if ($entry) { $entry.($pair[1]) } else { $null }; if ($null -eq $value) { Remove-ItemProperty $i.PSPath -Name $pair[0] -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } else { Set-ItemProperty $i.PSPath -Name $pair[0] -Value $value -Type DWord } } }

name: Stop sharing updates with other PCs
description: Windows can upload update files to other computers in the background, which eats upload bandwidth and raises ping. This keeps updates downloading from Microsoft only.
